create_barcode.description: Turn a product number, SKU, ticket ID or any short text into a barcode image, ready to print on a label or drop into a document. Choose the format or let it pick one, and set the colours and size. Retail numbers get their check digit added or checked for you. No account or API key required.
create_barcode.name: create_barcode

parameters.description: What the barcode should hold, such as a product number or a stock code. It has to fit on one line.
parameters.name: text

parameters.description: The kind of barcode. Pick automatically lets barcodeapi.org choose one that fits the text, such as EAN-13 for a product number or a QR code for a link. Choose a type when a scanner, a label printer or a retailer expects a particular one.
parameters.name: barcode_type

options.label: UPC-A, retail products in North America
UPC-E, small packs in North America
Data Matrix, small parts and labels
PDF417, ID cards and boarding passes

parameters.description: Print the barcode's text under it in plain characters, so a person can read and type it if a scanner fails. Only line barcodes have this.
parameters.display_name: Show the text under the bars
parameters.name: show_text

parameters.description: The colour of the bars, as a hex colour. It has to be clearly darker than the background or scanners will not read it. QR and Aztec codes always come out black on white.
parameters.name: foreground_color

parameters.description: The colour behind the bars, as a hex colour. Keep it light so the bars stand out.
parameters.name: background_color

parameters.description: How tall the bars are, in millimetres when printed at the image's resolution, between 10 and 150. Only line barcodes have this.
parameters.name: height

parameters.description: How big the image is. Large and Extra large are sharper for printing on labels. QR and Aztec codes always come out at their standard size.
parameters.name: size

parameters.description: Optional. The name to save the image under. Named after what the barcode holds by default, e.g. sku-1001-barcode.png.
parameters.name: filename

create_barcodes.description: Make a barcode for every value in a list, such as a column of product numbers, all in one format, and get them back as one zip file of images with a result for each value. A value that cannot be made is reported with the reason and the rest carry on. Up to 250 at a time. No account or API key required.

create_qr_code.description: Turn a link or any other text into a QR code image, ready to print, email or drop into a document. Choose the size and how much damage it can survive. The image is saved so later steps can attach or upload it. No account or API key required.

description: Make barcodes with barcodeapi.org: product barcodes (EAN-13, UPC-A), stock and shipping labels (Code 128, Code 39, ITF-14), QR codes, Data Matrix, PDF417 and Aztec. Make one at a time, or a whole list at once as a zip file of images, with the colours, size and printed text chosen for you or set as you like. Retail numbers get their check digit added or checked, and anything that will not fit is explained before it is printed. No account or API key required.
